Middle School Math Teacher (Grades 6–8) – 2027/28 School Year
Riverside Independent School District · Houston, TX

Riverside ISD serves 18,000 students across 24 campuses. Salary starts at $62,000 with a $3,000 signing bonus for math teachers.

The teacher will plan and deliver standards-aligned mathematics instruction, assess student progress and communicate regularly with families.

Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree from an accredited university
- Valid Texas teaching certification in Mathematics (Grades 4–8 or 7–12)
- Strong classroom management skills
- Must pass a criminal background check and fingerprinting
- Master's degree preferred
- Bilingual (Spanish) or Special Education certification highly desirable

Benefits include TRS pension, health insurance, summers off and a $1,500 technology stipend.

Riverside ISD does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability or age.
